claims: Michigan defeated UConn 69-63 in the men's National Championship game.
The men's National Championship game was on Monday, April 6, 2026.
Michigan won their first title since 1989.
The 2026 NCAA tournament concluded at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis.
Michigan Wolverines are the Men's Champions.
UCLA Bruins are the Women's Champions.
UCLA Bruins defeated South Carolina on April 5
